units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 11:2">Targ. I Sam. XI, 2</cite> <cite ref="M01289"><he>מִיקַּר</he></cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="M01289"><he>מֵיקַר</he></cite>); a. e.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 963:2">Yalk. Prov. 963</cite> <he>דין נָקֵיר וכ׳</he> the one (the raven) picks the eye out, and the other (the eagle) eats it; Midr. Sam. ch. VII <cite ref="N00032"><he>נָאקֵר</he></cite>.—Pesik. B’shall., p. 93ᵇ one worm <he>דעתידא דנַקְרָא וכ׳</he> which shall bite me behind the ear.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:1:4">Y. Sabb. XII, beg. 13ᶜ</cite> <he>ההן דנ׳ כיפין וכ׳</he> he who chisels stones, columns, millstones &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>נְקִיר</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 80b:2">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>אם איתא דנ׳ וכ׳</he> if it had been picked at (by the hens after drinking of a red liquid), it would have been noticeable.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="N01241">same</cite>. Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ top <he>הוה מְנַקְּרָא בתאינייא</he> a serpent had been biting at figs.—
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 10a:15">M. Kat. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>דקא מְנַקֵּר ריחיא</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="N01241"><he>נְקַרִ</he></cite>) whetted millstones &c.
